item.title: Building an OpenWrt Parental Control System with Gemini 3.7 and Open-Sourcing It
item.description: As a busy working parent frustrated by fragile screen-time limits and clunky router plugins, I teamed up with Gemini 3.7 Flash in Antigravity to build and open-source ParentControl Guard.
